title: A study of disturbance observers with unknown relative degree of the plant
author: Nam H. Jo; Youngjun Joo; Hyungbo Shim
locator: Robust stability of DOB when actual and nominal plant relative degrees differ; Q-filter design conditions
notes: Peer-reviewed theoretical study reports that a sufficiently fast Q-filter can destabilize DOB closed loops when actual plant relative degree is unknown or differs from nominal model. Motivates modeling actuator dynamics and delays; not a numeric bandwidth limit for a machine axis.
